title: POLARIS source catalogue: NASA-recommended sources plus reproducibility datasets

sources.name: NASA LROC QuickMap
sources.role: Visual reconnaissance and topographic context for two chosen sites; website for human verification, not machine-ingested as tile data
sources.status: linked and referenced in UI; manual review supported

sources.name: NASA Moon Trek
sources.role: Interactive south-pole cartographic atlas using NASA WMTS solar illumination and mean Earth visibility layers
sources.status: real NASA WMTS tiles displayed in atlas; published aggregate maps, not live mission results

sources.name: JPL Horizons
sources.role: Actual geodetic observer apparent solar and terrestrial azimuth/elevation by date
sources.status: real source samples bundled; dynamic API mode requires internet

sources.name: NASA Goddard LOLA
sources.role: Surface elevations and 6 km horizon surrounding two fixed points, 5m/pixel original
sources.status: two NASA DEM GeoTIFF files examined, 80MB originals not bundled; SHA256 and derived profiles stored

sources.name: NAIF SPICE
sources.role: Independent numerical validation of Horizons positions, not the relief
sources.status: 228 angle comparison values verified, rerun program provided

science_boundary: Lunar landing certification, far terrain, communications link budget, thermal survival and exact PV orientation are not included.
